theorem result
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (lambda : ℝ)
    {phi : ℝ → H} {v a y : H} {t : ℝ} (hphi : HasDerivAt phi v t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => ‖(N : ℝ)⁻¹ • (a + phi s) - y‖ ^ 2)
      ((2 / (N : ℝ)) * ⟪(N : ℝ)⁻¹ • (a + phi t) - y, v⟫_ℝ) t ∧
    HasDerivAt (fun s => ((N : ℝ) / lambda) * ‖(N : ℝ)⁻¹ • (a + phi s) - y‖ ^ 2)
      ((2 / lambda) * ⟪(N : ℝ)⁻¹ • (a + phi t) - y, v⟫_ℝ) t
approved_definition_context: H is a real inner-product normed space; completeness is not assumed. Real inverse and division use their standard totalized operations.
